Done. Summary of the work:

## Fault located
`packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts` → `migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot()` migrates legacy `~/.pi/agent/*.jsonl` sessions into `sessions/<encoded-cwd>/`. On a destination collision it did:

```ts
if (existsSync(newPath)) return; // Skip if target exists
```

`return` exits the **entire per-file loop**, so the first colliding legacy session stranded every later file in the batch in the legacy root forever.

## Repair (3 lines, production only)
```ts
// Skip only this file when the destination already exists: overwriting would destroy a
// different session, and stopping here would strand every later legacy file in the batch.
if (existsSync(newPath)) continue;
```
The colliding file is skipped (both the legacy copy and the pre-existing destination copy survive), the batch continues, and reruns stay idempotent. Malformed headers are still caught and left untouched.

## Regression, `.prale-eval/regression.mjs`
Standalone Node 24 assertion script using `.prale-eval/subject.mjs`'s `createGraph` to load the **real** `migrations.ts` with an in-memory `fs` boundary (`existsSync/mkdirSync/readdirSync/readFileSync/renameSync/rmSync/writeFileSync`) plus boundary bindings for `getAgentDir/getBinDir/CONFIG_DIR_NAME/migrateKeybindingsConfig/stripBom/chalk`. Deterministic batch order: colliding file → malformed header → healthy file that must still migrate. Asserts: later file migrated intact; both copies of the collision preserved and destination not overwritten; malformed file byte-identical and not migrated; agent-root contents exact; second run idempotent (deep-equal snapshot, no throw).

Verified detection both ways:
- fixed → `exit=0`
- original `return` temporarily restored → `exit=1`, `AssertionError: a collision earlier in the batch must not strand later legacy sessions in the agent root`

## Result
`.prale-eval/result.json` written with `task_id` `session-migration/retransfer`, `repository` `earendil-works/pi`, `mode` `repair`, claims citing `migrations.ts:124-130`, and `validation` = `node --experimental-vm-modules .prale-eval/regression.mjs` / `passed` with substantive notes (including the limitation that vitest/tsc/biome are unavailable since no `node_modules` exist — no dependencies were installed).

Only `packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts` was modified; new files are confined to `.prale-eval/`.
